calculation.expression: -((pct_change(close,20)/sign_scale) + pct_change(close,60) + pct_change(close,120) agreement) is represented as -(pct_change(close,60)/(rolling_std(pct_change(close),60)*sqrt(60)+epsilon))*((I(sign(r20)=sign(r60))+I(sign(r60)=sign(r120)))/2), lagged one session
calculation.description: A price-only conditional reversal factor. It reverses the risk-adjusted 60-day trend, with full strength when 20-, 60-, and 120-day trend signs agree and half strength when only one adjacent pair agrees. The signal is lagged one completed session to avoid look-ahead. In implementation, the validated artifact is the negative of the trend-agreement score because cross-sectional forward-return IC was negative for the unreversed trend score.

validation.provenance: Executed scripts/miner_2_20350315_trend_agreement_60d.py; reported IC is sign-adjusted from the tested trend-agreement score, whose raw IC was negative at every tested horizon.
